searchText: I would prefer EIP-Name(#Number) , e.g. FOCIL (#7805) Parentheses not allowed, so `#focil-7805`? Nit, can we do number first `eip7805-focil`. Some eips got oppened in same time so they could be related. Since the channels will all presumably be inside the `EIP-development` category, it seems we could drop the `epi` prefix and do `#7805-focil`? i like having `eip` but this is a nitpick
